name: Perlin power fractal (PowerNoiseSuite)
plain: Classic 3D Perlin summed over octaves with an extra exponent on amplitude, then remapped into [0,1]. Used as initial latent noise or blended into a per-step noise.
math:
n(p) = gradient noise, fade t ↦ 6t⁵−15t⁴+10t³.
M = Σ_k n(X·lac^k/scale,…)·(pers^k)^exp·pers^k. defaults octaves=4, persist=.5, lac=2, exp=4, scale=100.
M ← minmax(M,min,max); L ← (M+brightness)(1+contrast); L ← minmax(L). Z advances by evolution·frame or batch.

props.normalizes_variance: no: [0,1] output; PPFN latent adjust is a separate node

label: from code
surprise: Permutation table has size max(w,h)² rather than the standard 256, so memory and table differ with resolution.
